title: Field Guide: Everyday Home & Living Spaces

words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我已经吃饱了，谢谢。(Wǒ yǐjīng chī bǎo le, xièxie.) — I am already full, thank you.
睡觉前别忘了关灯。(Shuìjiào qián bié wàng le guān dēng.) — Don't forget to turn off the light before sleeping.
请去开门。(Qǐng qù kāi mén.) — Please go open the door.
躺在舒服的沙发上休息。(Tǎng zài shūfu de shāfā shang xiūxi.) — Lying on the comfortable couch resting.
进屋请换上干净的拖鞋。(Jìn wū qǐng huàn shang gānjìng de tuōxié.) — Please switch into clean slippers upon entering.
这条新毛巾吸水性特别好。(Zhè tiáo xīn máojīn xīshuǐ xìng tèbié hǎo.) — This new towel is very absorbent.
请帮客人倒水。(Qǐng bāng kèrén dào shuǐ.) — Please pour water for the guest.
饭前一定要先洗手。(Fàn qián yídìng yào xiān xǐ shǒu.) — Be sure to wash hands before meals.
把冷饭放进微波炉热两分钟。(Bǎ lěng fàn fàng jìn wēibōlú rè liǎng fēnzhōng.) — Heat cold rice in the microwave for two minutes.
出门记得带钥匙和手机。(Chūmén jìde dài yàoshi hé shǒujī.) — Remember to take your keys and phone when going out.
洗干净的外套挂在衣柜里。(Xǐ gānjìng de wàitào guà zài yīguì lǐ.) — Hang clean jackets in the wardrobe.
进门把鞋子整齐地放在鞋架上。(Jìnmén bǎ xiézi zhěngqí de fàng zài xiéjià shang.) — Place shoes neatly on the shoe rack upon entering.
冬天睡觉盖厚一点的被子。(Dōngtiān shuìjiào gài hòu yìdiǎnr de bèizi.) — Sleep under a thicker quilt in winter.
这个记忆棉枕头很舒服。(Zhè ge jìyìmián zhěntou hěn shūfu.) — This memory foam pillow is very comfortable.
出门前在穿衣镜子前整理一下。(Chūmén qián zài chuānyī jìngzi qián zhěnglǐ yíxià.) — Tidy up before the full-length mirror before heading out.
吃完晚饭后弟弟负责扫地。(Chī wán wǎnfàn hòu dìdi fùzé sǎo dì.) — Younger brother sweeps the floor after dinner.
地板弄脏了，我来拖地。(Dìbǎn nòng zāng le, wǒ lái tuō dì.) — The floor got dirty, I will mop it.
下楼顺便倒垃圾。(Xià lóu shùnbiàn dào lājī.) — Take out the trash on your way downstairs.
衣服洗好了，拿到阳台去晾衣服。(Yīfu xǐ hǎo le, ná dào yángtái qù liàng yīfu.) — Clothes are washed, bring them to the balcony to dry.
用电开水壶烧一壶热水。(Yòng diàn kāishuǐhú shāo yì hú rèshuǐ.) — Boil a pot of hot water with the electric kettle.
